convertibility_reason: Uses no indicators at all - pure price breakout logic with fixed SL/TP. No external libraries. Simple entry/exit rules with fixed or deposit-fraction sizing. All logic is self-contained and straightforward to convert.

derived_values.name: a1 - opening price of current bar
derived_values.formula: tick.bid at moment of new bar detection

other_exits: SL and TP set at order entry only; no dynamic exit logic

position_sizing.conditional_logic: if RISK==0 use fixed BASELOT (0.1); if RISK>0 calculate as (AccountFreeMargin*0.9/margin_per_lot)*RISK, capped at broker max_lot

custom_logic_notes: Breakout EA: On each new bar, records the bid price as a1. Within the same bar, if price moves DELTA*point above a1, opens a SELL (counter-direction). If price moves DELTA*point below a1, opens a BUY (counter-direction). Only one trade signal per bar (br flag resets on new bar). SL for SELL is ask+SL*point (above entry), TP is bid-TP*point (below entry). SL for BUY is bid-SL*point (below entry), TP is ask+TP*point (above entry). The SL for SELL uses ask+SL*point which is correct for a sell stop-loss above the sell entry price. No check for existing positions before entering new trades - can stack positions. Timer-based (1 second interval) rather than OnTick. OrderCheck is called before OrderSend.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Timer-based polling can be replaced with tick-by-tick processing. New bar detection via bar timestamp comparison. The breakout logic (price moves DELTA pips from bar open) is simple to implement. Note the SL/TP are in raw point units (SL=100 points, TP=700 points), not pips - no digit adjustment is applied. RISK==0 branch uses fixed lot; RISK>0 branch uses free margin fraction. No position existence check - positions can accumulate. Must preserve the once-per-bar signal behavior (br flag).
